title: An Act to Establish Certain Positions Within the Maine Bureau of Veterans' Services

summary.text: This bill changes the titles of positions that must be filled by veterans that may be employed by the Director of the Maine Bureau of Veterans' Services within the Department of Defense, Veterans and Emergency Management to more closely align with current human resources job descriptions. It also adds several positions to the list of positions in the Maine Bureau of Veterans' Services that must be filled by veterans and corrects a cross-reference.
